raw_market.description:
In the second half of the NFL game between Bengals and Dolphins, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Dolphins score 7 or more points in the second half.

If the Dolphins score less than 7 points in the second half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on the Dolphins's second half score.

Points scored in the second half and in any overtime count toward this market. First-half points are not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
